_doc: CPU quarterback and play-caller for interactive CPU drives (play/qbAI.ts). Times in seconds. openMargin: seconds a receiver must beat the closest defender by before the QB throws to him; readNoise: error (s) judging a window. Difficulty cpuOffense sets accuracy: release error = chargeSigma / cpuOffense^2 (sweet spot half-width is 0.09). slotBias: seconds added to a receiver's read (Phase 3b: outside receivers first, so the corners see realistic target volume); checkdownAfter: the RB is only read after this time unless the QB is pressured.

hot._doc: Phase 3c: once the QB has noticed a surprise rush (sim.qbAlert, blitz.json surprise), he reads at once (no readStart): the hot receiver (sim.hot, the most open one) gets the ball if his window beats margin (s, with read noise); under pressure above bail he throws it away instead of taking the sack.

callsLate._doc: Phase 3c: 3rd and 4th down mixes (calls is 1st / 2nd down). Distance buckets: short = toGo <= shortTo, long = toGo >= longFrom, else normal. On 3rd / 4th and long the CPU never calls a designed run (run share 0); a scramble on a pass play is still possible.
